# Bettingbolagen pressas – Addnodes vd om kvartalet

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon (26 Oct 2026) covers a nervous market: the AI sell-off has spread from software to AI-infrastructure stocks, oil is above $140, Swedish producer prices rose 11.2% year on year, and Lula's unexpected election win in Brazil is weighing on iGaming stocks. Swedbank strategist Robert Oldstrand sees money rotating between sectors rather than a broad sell-off. He suggests buying the dip in Swedish industrial stocks and names SSAB, Peab (and construction stocks in general) and SCA as cases he likes. Addnode's CEO says the earlier share-price collapse came from normal contract-renewal swings in revenue being mistaken for AI damage, and he expects organic growth in 2027.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SCA-B — SCA | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Swedbank strategist says today's fall after the downgrade is overdone; expects quarter-on-quarter improvement, strong kraftliner, possible buybacks.

#### Reasoning

Guest strategist Robert Oldstrand (Swedbank) disagrees with the downgrade to hold. Kraftliner looks good, pulp and power prices may turn up, price/mix and volume are improving, and wind power adds upside. A very strong balance sheet would allow buybacks next year without straining it. He calls it 'helt okej case' and says 'det gillar vi'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if kraftliner prices/volumes weaken
- if pulp and electricity prices fail to recover
- if the expected quarter-on-quarter improvement doesn't come

> *"Faller kanske lite omotiverat mycket. Vi tycker att det kommer ses sekventuellt bättre ut för faktiskt SCA här framöver."*

---

### 🟢 PEAB-B — Peab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Swedbank strategist names Peab as a case they like ahead of Wednesday's report; builders look good overall.

#### Reasoning

Guest strategist (Swedbank) says construction companies are exposed to large investment trends (defense, data centers), with good margins, strong balance sheets and record order books.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order books decline
- if margins deteriorate in the Q3 report

> *"Sen dels så tycker jag det kan vara lite spännande med SSAB och Peab på onsdag. Det är två case vi gillar."*

---

### 🟢 SSAB-A — SSAB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Swedbank strategist names SSAB as one of two cases they like ahead of Wednesday's report.

#### Reasoning

Guest strategist Robert Oldstrand calls SSAB a preferred case. The episode gives no company-specific reasons; it falls under his broader view that Swedish industrials sold off without good reason and could be bought on the dip as 2027 estimate risk has come down.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report shows weakening demand
- if 2027 estimates are cut

> *"Det är två case vi gillar."*

---

### 🟠 ANOD-B — Addnode | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Back to organic growth, better profit; CEO expects Q4 flat on last year and organic growth in 2027; says no customers lost to AI.

#### Reasoning

This view comes from the company's own CEO, so it is not independent. The CEO says the share-price collapse came from the market mistaking normal revenue swings (customers picking 1-year instead of 3-year contracts) for AI damage. He reports a major 10-year Stockholm city contract, 40,000 customers, a 20% average profit growth record and organic growth expected in 2027. The shares are recovering, but no independent buy view was given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth does not come through in 2027
- if customers start leaving for AI-native tools
- if contract mix keeps shifting to shorter terms

> *"Vi kan redan nu se i våra böcker att vi borde kunna få en organisk tillväxt nästa år."*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited analyst downgrade from buy to hold after Friday's report; shares down about 3.5%.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst downgrade from buy to hold, reported by the hosts, not their own view. The episode does not give the analyst's reasoning.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further downgrades follow
- if defense order momentum slows

> *"De har fått en sänkt rekommendation till behåll från tidigare köp."*

---
